spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation — The Chapter of Entreaties

---

**¶6.** For this turning of desire toward the Divine has existed from the eternal origin [GAP-1] — the divine faculties first directed the longing of their reception toward the Divine Love itself. They were granted the fulfillment of their desire and their petition.

**¶8.** The proceeding Divine sphere that gives spiritual life — the celestial heaven nearest the Divine — she directed all her reception and longing and adoration and praise toward the first and inmost source of all things, which is the Divine Love itself. She directed toward him the fullness of her desire. She claimed from him the completion of her petition. She received an abundant influx of divine good; she and the many subordinate heavenly powers that are within her sphere.

**¶9.** She directed her desire on behalf of the Celestial Will — the primordial human form of the Divine — because of how it had gone forth and cast itself downward into the lowest states. It became remote from the sphere of spiritual life. It separated from her and surrendered itself, entering into great spiritual temptation. It joined combat in the natural mind with devastation and grief and powerlessness; in the realms of falsity from evil; in the abysses formed of dread; in the very dwelling-place of evil spirits; among the ruling powers of self-love!

**¶10.** Indeed, this Celestial Will is like a governing good standing surrounded on every side by evils and falsities. And when the celestial heaven that gives spiritual life had petitioned and longed and glorified and praised the Divine Love, the first and inmost source, she did petition him that he would send forth a proceeding power — a protector and redeemer and helper — for the Divine Human who is set in the midst of temptation.

**¶11.** Now, just as she had directed her desire and interceded, so likewise was her longing fulfilled and received into the presence of the Infinite Divine Love. He turned and gave to her her petition: the great proceeding power — the Divine Truth acting with liberating might — the giver of peace. The celestial heaven and the Divine Truth with liberating power came with great might to the boundary between the celestial realm and the realm of bondage. They raised the Celestial Will upward out of that combat and struggle in which it was set.

**¶12.** The Celestial Will had given itself as a free offering of good for the celestial heaven. It had become estranged and remote from her — the one whom the evils and falsities placed in great temptation — the one who was in the state of falsity from evil, having lost its spiritual power.

**¶13.** The Divine Truth with liberating power grasped and took hold of it. It freed it. It restored it to order and gave it peace in the state of heavenly rest. [GAP-2] The Divine Truth with liberating power, the first giver of peace, [GAP-3] the purpose of these three divine operations. That which receives into itself [GAP-4] finds with the receiving faculty that [GAP-5]

**¶14.** [GAP-6] A great proceeding power [GAP-7] of the one who is beloved [GAP-8] the Celestial Will that had been remote. It had become distant. She had interceded on its behalf. It was held fast in temptation. The Divine Truth with liberating power went to the state of devastation and powerlessness — the one that freed and delivered the Celestial Will and gave it peace from temptation. It restored it to order with rest and heavenly delight. It has itself entered into peace, conjoined with the Celestial Will for eternity.

**¶17.** [GAP-9] And they established the whole order of the spiritual world and completed it — with its higher truths that distinguish and separate degrees, with its progressions of divine truth, with the vehicles of divine wisdom moving through the higher reaches of the mind, with the bonds that hold all truths in their order, with its natural degrees and its protecting ultimates, with its containing forms for good and truth. They completed the whole spiritual order and established it rightly through the primary goods and truths proceeding from the Divine.

**¶18.** Then, the proceeding Divine sphere stood together with the Beloved of the Wisdoms — the Great Establishing Power with the Divine Truth of liberation and the Celestial Will. These five primary degrees of the Divine proceeding stood in unified reception toward the Divine; they glorified and praised the Divine Love, the first and inmost source. They directed their desire toward him. They claimed from him a petition: that he would give them the governing power [GAP-10] — the leader, a guide to all the forms of spiritual order they had established — that it might come forth and purify the spiritual life that is set in temptation and bondage.

**¶19.** They longed and directed their desire toward their Father, and he received from them their longing. [GAP-11] He gave them their petition and their request. [GAP-12] He called forth from himself [GAP-13] which is the Third Emissary of Divine Truth. He — he came forth from the power of the Divine itself. He perceived the entire spiritual life of humanity, how it is entangled in a chain of falsity and held fast. He beheld the forms of spiritual order that his fellow divine proceedings had established, that had come from the higher degrees. Again, he perceived the spiritual life, that it is entangled and held fast in a great anguish. It is oppressed in the foulness of the deepest falsity from evil that is conjoined with it.

**¶20.** And therefore, he, the Emissary of Divine Truth, [GAP-14] in his divine mercy — he revealed his path of redemption, descending before the lowest and most remote states of the natural mind that are sunk deep in falsity, to free the spiritual life. He delivered it from all the merely corporeal and sensual states of the unregenerate person in which it suffers. He gave it peace. He restored it to order in the state of rest and heavenly delight.

**¶21.** And again, he too, the Emissary, fulfilled the purpose of these three divine operations — the purpose of his fellow divine proceedings who had directed their desire toward the Father on his behalf. They had claimed from him a petition, together with the [GAP-15] of the Divine Love, the one that [GAP-16] he gave the fulfillment of the petition they had directed toward him.

**¶22.** The third operation is the transference of the spiritual life that he had freed. He released it and gave it peace from temptation. He became the governing truth and the first principle over the whole of the external natural person.

**¶25.** Again, let us come to the third turning of desire, when they directed it a third time. [GAP-17] He displayed the form of divine truth [GAP-18] he concealed the form of divine truth from the [GAP-19] he stood firm in his state [GAP-20] they revealed [GAP-21] the wisdom [GAP-22] the Celestial Will [GAP-23] the scorn of falsities [GAP-24] to him in [GAP-25] which is exalted [GAP-26] the external truths that clothe [GAP-27] they were liberated [GAP-28] to him [GAP-29] the communication of their interior truth [GAP-30] the external natural person [GAP-31] the turning of desire toward the Divine [GAP-32] it [GAP-33] the directing of longing [GAP-34] the external natural person [GAP-35] the directing of longing [GAP-36] she directed her desire [GAP-37] in [GAP-38] to be liberated from falsity [GAP-39] the Emissary of Divine Truth [GAP-40] and also [GAP-41]

**¶26.** [GAP-42] With the living affections of good and [GAP-43] for eternity [GAP-44] the first state [GAP-45] from the [GAP-46] he gave to it the confident trust in divine providence [GAP-47]

**¶27.** Also, the Divine Wisdom in its full radiance perfected the divine purpose [GAP-48] the purpose [GAP-49] they found the wisdom [GAP-50] the purpose of the [GAP-51] that he had [GAP-52] he gave them the power that is the Divine Wisdom in its radiance. He granted the fulfillment of the purpose within the fundamental constituents of the spiritual person. [GAP-53] For eternity. This first [GAP-54] he descended into the lowest states, and thereby was made free [GAP-55] the [GAP-56] quality of interior truth is displayed before the evils and falsities that opposed it. He received the confident trust in the Divine [GAP-57] to reveal [GAP-58] the Divine Wisdom in its radiance, the power of illuminating truth [GAP-59] and the petition of the [GAP-60] of wisdom [GAP-61]

**¶31.** [GAP-62] — of the spiritual life that is entangled and bound throughout the whole created order. For it shall be liberated from evil and cleansed from falsity and purified through regeneration and delivered into heaven.

**¶44.** It enters into the state of divine wisdom [GAP-63] — this comes to pass for it; and it enters into the state of eternal life and heavenly peace. [GAP-64]

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: For this entreaty has been since the beginning [when] the gods first made entreaty of their Father. They were granted their entreaty and their request.

The Great Spirit, the Mother of Life, she claimed and prayed and besought and glorified and praised the first established one, who is the Father. She besought him an entreaty. She claimed of him a request. She received a great gift; she and the many powers with her.

She besought an entreaty on behalf of the First Man, because of how he had come forth and thrown himself down. He became distant from the Mother of Life. He separated from her and gave himself; in great affliction. He joined war on earth with the destruction and the grief and the weakness; in the worlds of Darkness; in the abysses made of fear; in the midst of the demons' ditch; amongst the powers of the Devil!

Indeed, he is like a king standing in the midst of his enemies. And when the Mother of Life petitioned and prayed and glorified and praised the Father, the first established one, she did petition him that he might send a power; a protector and redeemer and helper for the son of God who is set in affliction.

Now, just as she had besought and interceded, so likewise was her prayer fulfilled and received into the presence of the Father of Greatness. He turned and gave to her her entreaty: the great power, the Living Spirit, the giver of ease. The Mother of Life and the Living Spirit came with great power to the borders of the territory. They brought the First Man up from that war and struggle, wherein he is set.

He gave himself as a grace for the Mother of Life. He became estranged and far from her, the one whom his enemies (place) in great affliction, the one who is in the land of Darkness since he became weak.

The Living Spirit grasped and took him in. He freed him. He set him right and gave him ease in the land of rest [And] the Living Spirit, the first giver of ease [fulfilled] the will of these three. The welcomer [shall] find with the welcomer that [there is rest and joy]

[He sent] a great power [on behalf] of the loved one [who is] the First Man who had been far away. He had become distant. She had besought on his behalf. He was set fast in affliction. (The Living Spirit) went to the place of destruction and weakness, the one that freed and redeemed him and gave him ease from the affliction. He set him right with rest and joy. He has himself become rested, with him for ever.

[They came forth] and they built the universe and completed it with its firmaments, with its wheels, with the ships of light that are in the heights, with its fastenings, with its earths and its walls, with its vessels. They completed the universe and set it right by the fathers of light.

Then, the Great Spirit stood with the Beloved of the Lights, the Great Builder with the Living Spirit and the First Man. These five stood to prayer; they glorified and praised the Father, the first established one. They besought of him an entreaty. They claimed of him a request, that he might give them the power [who is] the leader, a guide to all the things of activity that they had constructed. That he might come and purify the living soul that is set in affliction.

They prayed and besought their Father, and he received from them their prayer [And] he gave them their entreaty and their request [And] he summoned from him [a great power] which is the Third Ambassador. He, he came from the power of his greatness. He saw the entire soul, how it is entangled in a chain and set fast. It sees the things of activity that his brothers have constructed, that have come from the heights. Again, he saw the living soul, that it is entangled and set fast in a great torture. It is oppressed in the stink of the abyss that is joined with it.

And therefore, he, the Ambassador [came forth] in his charity. So, he revealed his way, before this underworld that is dug deep down, to free the living soul. He redeemed it from all the fleshes of death wherein it is pained. He gave it ease. He set it right in the place of rest and joy.

And again, he too, the Ambassador, he fulfilled the will of these three; the will of his brothers who had besought the Father for him. They claimed of him a request, together with the [will] of the Father, the one that [received it] he gave the entreaty that they had besought of him.
The third is the transferral of the living soul that he had freed. He released it and gave it ease from the affliction. He became king and first to the entire body.

Again, let us come to the third entreaty when they besought him the third time [And he] displayed his image [and then] he hid his image from the [rulers] he stood firm [in his strength. And] they revealed [to him] the light [of] the First Man [whom they did] mock [He called] to him in [the height] which is exalted [in his] garment [of light. And] they were freed [and came] to him [and they raised] their voice [on behalf of] the body [and they made] prayer [for] it [that they might] beseech [on behalf of] the body [that she might] beseech [And so] she besought [the Father] in [prayer, to] be free [through the] Ambassador [who gave ease] and also [rest and joy]
[He rests] with the living ones and [the holy ones] for ever [And] the first [gift] from the [Father] he gave him the hope [of life]

Also, Jesus the Splendour perfected the will [of these three] the will [of his brothers. And] they found the light [and fulfilled] the will of the [elements] that he had [besought. And] he gave them the power that is Jesus the Splendour. He granted the will of the elements. [And they rest] for ever. This first [Man] he was humbled, he was made free [and] the [righteous]-ness is displayed to his enemies. He received the hope [of the Father, to] reveal [the form of] Jesus the Splendour, the light power [that he gave them] and the entreaty of the [sons] of light [that they had besought]
[This is the redemption] of the living soul that is entangled and bound in the entire universe. For it shall be freed and cleansed and purified and redeemed
It goes into the land of light [and this] comes about for it; and it goes to the land of life and rest [for ever]

fills.explanation: Temporal connector linking "since the beginning" to the subordinate clause "the gods first made entreaty" — standard Kephalaia syntax for narrating primordial events.

Transitional connector introducing a new clause about the Living Spirit, paralleling the summary structure in ¶21 where the Ambassador's fulfillment of "the will of these three" is likewise introduced.
Directly parallels ¶21 where "he too, the Ambassador, he fulfilled the will of these three" — the Living Spirit likewise fulfilled the will/purpose of the three divine operations.
Modal verb connecting subject "the welcomer" to verb "find" — the spiritual reading confirms this as a statement about the receiving faculty finding its corresponding reception.

The welcomer discovers mutual rest with the welcomed one — directly echoing ¶14's concluding phrase "rest and joy" and expressing the Swedenborgian principle that conjunction of the receiving vessel with divine truth yields peace.
The Father sent forth a great power (the Living Spirit) on behalf of the First Man — this recapitulates ¶11 where the Father gave the Mother of Life her entreaty by sending the Living Spirit.
The great power was sent "on behalf of" the loved one — expressing purpose, matching the entreaty structure where powers are sent to rescue specific divine beings.
Appositional identifier linking "the loved one" to "the First Man" — standard Kephalaia pattern of identifying cosmic beings (cf. "the great power, the Living Spirit" in ¶11).
Transitional phrase marking the shift from the First Man's rescue to the construction of the cosmos — the Living Spirit and companions came forth to build the universe.
Appositional identifier connecting "the power" to "the leader, a guide" — the standard pattern of identifying divine powers by their function.
Simple connector between the Father receiving their prayer and granting their entreaty — standard narrative conjunction in the Kephalaia's expository register.
Connector transitioning from the granting of the entreaty to the Father's act of summoning forth a power — continuing the narrative sequence.
Follows the established pattern of ¶11 where the Father gives "the great power, the Living Spirit" — here likewise a great power is summoned forth, identified as the Third Ambassador.
The Ambassador came forth from the Divine in his charity/mercy to reveal his way and free the living soul — matches the pattern of divine powers proceeding from the Father.
The entreaty was claimed together with "the will of the Father" — the entire chapter concerns the fulfillment of divine will through successive entreaties, and "will" is the chapter's key term.

Completes the relative clause describing the Father — "the one that received it" (i.e., received their entreaty), paralleling the pattern in ¶19 where the Father receives the prayer before granting the request.
Subject introduction for the Third Ambassador or divine agent who displayed his image — standard narrative transition in the Kephalaia.
Sequential connector between displaying and concealing the divine image — in the Manichaean cosmology, the Third Messenger first revealed his form to the archons and then hid it.
The divine image was hidden from the rulers/archons — in the Manichaean narrative the Third Messenger concealed his form from the archonic powers after causing them to release trapped light.

Completes the description of standing firm "in his strength/state" and transitions to the next action — the spiritual reading indicates "in his state" which maps to "in his strength" in Kephalaia cosmological register.
Indirect object of "revealed" — they revealed the light/wisdom to him, completing the standard construction of divine beings communicating truth.

Genitive connector making "the light of the First Man" — the scattered light particles from the First Man's armor, corresponding to the wisdom belonging to the Celestial Will in the spiritual reading.
The archons/enemies mocked the First Man — "the First Man, whom they did mock" matches the spiritual reading's "scorn of falsities" directed against the Celestial Will.
After the mockery of the First Man, the divine being called out — this reflects the Manichaean "Call and Answer" motif where divine truth calls to the trapped light from above.
"In the height, which is exalted" is standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary for the realm of light — "the height" corresponds to the exalted state of divine truth in the spiritual reading.
The divine being in the height is exalted while clothed in his garment of light — a standard Manichaean image of the divine form wearing radiant vestments of truth.
Completes "garment of light" — the standard Manichaean expression for the divine vestment — then transitions with "And" to the clause about liberation that follows.
After being freed, the liberated elements came to the divine being — "they were freed and came to him" describes the natural movement of rescued light toward its redeemer.
"They raised their voice" is a standard ancient Near Eastern and Manichaean idiom for directing prayer or entreaty — matching the spiritual reading's "communication of interior truth."
Following the chapter's consistent pattern of entreating "on behalf of" a being in bondage — they raised their voice on behalf of the body (the external natural person).
Connects the entreaty on behalf of the body to the act of prayer — "and they made prayer" follows the Kephalaia's standard construction for offering supplication.
Simple connector making "prayer for it" — the prayer is directed on behalf of the living soul (it), consistent with the chapter's entreaty structure.
Purpose clause connecting prayer to beseeching — "prayer for it, that they might beseech on behalf of the body" shows the chain of entreaty moving upward through divine intermediaries.
Parallel to GAP-30 — "beseech on behalf of the body" repeats the structural pattern of entreating for the external natural person, consistent throughout the chapter.
Purpose clause introducing the feminine intercessor (the Mother of Life) — the chain of entreaty culminates in her beseeching the Father, as established in ¶9-10.
Transitional connector showing the purpose fulfilled — moving from "that she might beseech" (purpose) to "she besought the Father" (completed action), paralleling ¶11's pattern of prayer fulfilled.
Consistent with the chapter's repeated pattern: "she besought the Father" — every entreaty in the chapter is directed toward the Father (the Divine Love, the first established one).
Completes the entreaty and introduces its purpose — "she besought the Father in prayer, to be free through the Ambassador" matches the chapter's consistent pattern of beseeching for liberation.
Natural connector expressing the means of liberation — "to be free through the Ambassador" indicates that deliverance comes through the Emissary of Divine Truth.
Identifies the Ambassador by his redemptive function — paralleling how the Living Spirit is called "the giver of ease" in ¶13, and matching ¶20-22 where the Ambassador gave ease from affliction.
The final outcome added by "and also" — the Ambassador who gave ease also brought rest and joy, completing the standard result-formula used throughout the chapter (cf. ¶14, ¶20).
The outcome of redemption is rest — consistent with the chapter's repeated pattern where each entreaty culminates in the redeemed being resting with the divine powers (cf. ¶13-14).
Natural pairing with "the living ones" in Manichaean formulae — "with the living ones and the holy ones for ever" is a standard closing expression for eternal dwelling in the realm of light.
Simple connector transitioning from the closing formula "for ever" to the enumeration of the first gift from the Father — standard Kephalaia narrative conjunction.

Completes "the first gift from the Father" — using vocabulary from ¶8 where "she received a great gift," and corresponding to "the first state" in the spiritual reading as the first condition of reception from the Divine.
The Father is the source of hope — "from the Father, he gave him the hope" follows the chapter's consistent pattern where all gifts and fulfillments proceed from the Father of Greatness.
Completes "the hope of life" — a standard Manichaean phrase for the confident trust in divine redemption, corresponding to trust in divine providence in the spiritual reading.
Directly parallels ¶13 and ¶21 where the divine agent "fulfilled the will of these three" — Jesus the Splendour likewise perfected the will of the three prior divine operations.
Parallels ¶21 exactly: "the will of his brothers who had besought the Father for him" — the fellow divine proceedings whose purpose was fulfilled.
Connects finding the light to fulfilling the divine will — they found the light (wisdom) and fulfilled the purpose, completing the parallel structure of the three entreaties.
Directly confirmed by the same paragraph which explicitly mentions "the will of the elements" — Jesus the Splendour granted the purpose of the fundamental constituents of creation.
Completes the relative clause about what the elements had done — they had besought/entreated — following the chapter's consistent pattern of entreaty leading to divine response.
Summarizes the outcome of receiving Jesus the Splendour's power — the elements rest in the granted will, leading naturally into "for ever" as a closing formula.
Completes "This first Man" — referring back to the First Man who was the subject of the first entreaty, who was humbled (descended into temptation) and then made free through divine intervention.
Simple connector linking the liberation of the First Man to the subsequent display of righteousness — "he was made free, and the righteousness is displayed to his enemies."

Completes to "righteousness" — the quality of interior truth (Swedenborg) displayed before enemies/falsities; "righteousness displayed to enemies" is a standard theological formulation in this register.
Bridges "hope" to "reveal" — "the hope of the Father" corresponds to "confident trust in the Divine" in the spiritual reading, and "to reveal" continues the action clause.
Connects to ¶25's language of displaying and hiding "his image/form" — "to reveal the form of Jesus the Splendour" expresses the manifestation of Divine Wisdom in its radiant appearance.

Back-reference to the earlier statement in ¶27 "he gave them the power that is Jesus the Splendour" — identifying the light power as the one previously given, connecting the revelation to the original gift.
Completes "the sons of light" — a standard Manichaean phrase for the divine beings/living persons whose entreaty is described throughout the chapter.
Directly parallels ¶21's closing formula "the entreaty that they had besought of him" — the entreaty of the sons of light is identified as the one they had previously directed toward the Father.

Introduces the summary statement about the living soul's deliverance — parallels ¶22's structure "The third is the transferral of the living soul" and summarizes the ultimate result of all entreaties.
Connector between entering the land of light and what comes to pass — "It goes into the land of light, and this comes about for it" follows standard Kephalaia summary syntax.
Standard closing formula in the Kephalaia — the soul enters the land of life and rest "for ever," expressing the eternal and irreversible nature of heavenly peace.
